official_site: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us.html (Cutler-Hammer is an Eaton brand; products are on eaton.com)
reachable: yes with full browser headers (Akamai); plain curl fails
platform: Adobe AEM (eaton.com) with Scene7 dynamic media (dynamicmedia.eaton.com)
catalog_endpoint: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/skuPage.<SKU>.html (JSON-LD Product with sku; og:image; image URLs https://www.eaton.com/mdmfiles/<PDMid>/<asset>_<C|L|R|T>/1000x1000_300dpi which 302 to https://dynamicmedia.eaton.com/is/image/eaton/<asset>?wid=1000&hei=1000...). SKU sitemap https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us.skusitemap.xml lists only 3,722 SKUs and none of the samples.
est_products: unknown (eaton.com SKU sitemap is partial: 3,722 US URLs)
sku_format_match: yes - eaton.com sku pages use the exact catalog numbers (QC2060, GHB3035, CSR2200N, BAB2040, HMCP150T4C all resolved; JSON-LD sku equals the sample)
recommended_strategy: For each SKU GET https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/skuPage.<SKU>.html with full Chrome headers; confirm JSON-LD "sku" == SKU; take og:image (1000x1000 300dpi JPEG) plus the other mdmfiles .../1000x1000_300dpi URLs in the page. Throttle hard (robots Crawl-delay 20 s; ~218 SKUs ~ 75 min at that rate). Flag images whose asset name differs from the SKU as family/representative images. Same pipeline as the Eaton brand.
blockers: Akamai bot protection (needs full browser header set); Crawl-delay 20; some images are shared family images. Akamai: plain curl gets HTTP/2 INTERNAL_ERROR or 30 s timeouts; it works (HTTP 200) when full Chrome headers are sent (sec-ch-ua, sec-ch-ua-platform, Sec-Fetch-Dest/Mode/Site/User, Upgrade-Insecure-Requests, Accept with image/avif). robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 20. Some SKUs show a representative family image rather than their own (e.g. CHN230GF -> CH250GFT_*, GHB3035 -> GHB3100_*, BAB2040 -> BAB2020_360-*, HMCP150T4C -> HMCP007C0_R).
